user.title: Budget Thuis Dynamic Prices
user.description: Add Budget Thuis dynamic electricity price sensors. This reads the public tariff page and requires no account or API key. Only one instance is needed per Home Assistant install.

abort.already_configured: Budget Thuis Dynamic Prices is already set up.

init.title: Contract pricing
init.description: Inkoopvergoeding is your contract's own purchasing fee - enter it including BTW, exactly as the Budget Thuis app shows it under your tariff; there's a separate one for electricity (per kWh) and gas (per m³). Energiebelasting isn't asked here: it's a government tax rate, already published per hour on the tariff page, so it's applied automatically. Beursprijs (the live market price) is also fetched automatically - do not enter it below. The defaults are a starting point, not guaranteed to match your contract. The ZonneBonus applies to the export price from 2027; set the percentage to 0 if Budget Thuis ends the promotion.

data.beursprijs_markup: Extra correction on top of the live beursprijs (EUR/kWh, leave at 0 unless you have a specific reason)
data.zonnebonus_percent: ZonneBonus on exported energy from 2027 (%, 0 = off)
data.zonnebonus_max_beursprijs: ZonneBonus: maximum market price the bonus applies to (EUR/kWh)
data.zonnebonus_until: ZonneBonus until and including (date, empty = no end)
